title: Japanese Donburi Rice Bowl
description: A classic Japanese dish made with grilled chicken and flavorful rice.
instructions: Cook the Japanese rice according to the package instructions.
Grill the chicken breast until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Slice the grilled chicken into thin strips.
Heat the Japanese chicken broth in a saucepan over medium heat.
Add the sliced chicken to the hot broth and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Serve the chicken and broth over the cooked Japanese rice.
Garnish with sliced green onions and sesame seeds.
